title: PUT /api/notes/<noteId>/clone-to-branch/<branchId> with no request body returns 500 and leaks a minified variable name to the caller
statement: cloneNoteToBranch destructures `const { prefix } = req.body` without a guard, and express.json() leaves req.body undefined when no JSON body is sent, so a bodyless request answers HTTP 500 with the message "Cannot destructure property 'prefix' of 'e.body' as it is undefined." That is an internal error where a 400 belongs, and the message exposes the bundler's minified identifier. The identical request with {"prefix": null} succeeds, and the sibling cloneNoteToParentNote has the same unguarded shape.

handVerified.note: Report section 7. No board red: it surfaced while authoring step 13 of note-properties-are-searchable.api.1, the corpus's only bodyless clone step (that scenario's recorded board failure at step 16 is F9, not this). Control: same note, same branch, same session, body {"prefix": null} returns 200 with a branchId.

source.howDecided: No commit touches routes/api/cloning.ts between the tested commit and head; the blob is identical at tested, head and v0.105.0. Re-read at head: the unguarded `const { prefix } = req.body;` is still at :7 in cloneNoteToBranch and at :14 in cloneNoteToParentNote. The in-repo counterexample the report cites has moved: undeleteNote's `const { fallbackParentNoteId } = req.body ?? {};` is at routes/api/notes.ts:219 today, not :213, and it is followed at :221-222 by an explicit ValidationError on a bad type, which is a better model to point at than the report noted.

newItems.title: Anthropic LLM provider fails to list models: "Cannot destructure property 'baseUrl' of 'e.body' as it is undefined"
newItems.note: Not this route, but the identical defect class and the identical leaked-minified-identifier message shape on a different endpoint. Closed 2026-02-22 as not_planned, so the class was never addressed repo-wide. Useful to cite as precedent that this failure mode has been seen before and left open.

queries: gh search issues --repo TriliumNext/Trilium '"Cannot destructure property"'

reevaluation: Stands and is unreported for this route. Source is unchanged and shipped in v0.105.0. One thing did turn up that the report did not have: #8636 shows the exact same 'Cannot destructure property X of e.body' failure on the LLM-provider route, filed in February and closed as not_planned. That cuts both ways for the filer: it proves the pattern is real and recurring, and it warns that a narrowly framed report of the same shape has already been declined once, so the issue should be framed around the missing 400-vs-500 guard on the cloning routes (both of them) with the undeleteNote guard as the in-repo precedent, rather than around the error string. Severity is low-to-moderate: no data loss, no auth bypass, but any client that omits an optional body gets an opaque 500.
notes: Cite routes/api/notes.ts:219-222 (today's numbers, not the report's :213) as the pattern the codebase already uses. Cover both cloning.ts:7 and :14 in one issue. Mention #8636 as prior art but do not lean on it as a duplicate; it was closed not_planned and its subject is the LLM route. Consider filing this together with F12 if the maintainers prefer one 'unguarded req.body returns 500' issue.
